combined_pytest.command: .venv/bin/pytest -q -rs tests/test_card_source_aliases.py tests/test_card_all_status_genes.py tests/test_card_unresolved_names.py tests/test_card_gene_reference_followup.py tests/test_card_species_gene_context.py tests/test_acr_reference_context.py tests/test_card_complex_members.py tests/test_card_literature_expansion.py tests/test_card_literature_proteins.py tests/test_card_reference_lineages.py tests/test_mex_component_references.py
combined_pytest.skip: test_card_reference_lineages.test_offline_native_replay: known qualification deltas lack historical fixtures; public artifact checks still run

checks: Exact RDF predicate, literal value, language and source identity are required before accepting a planned alias lead.
Gene names, gene synonyms, ordered loci, ORFs and primary or secondary accessions cannot substitute for one another.
Reference qualification requires independently cached active taxonomy and complete species identity agreement.
Wrong-species matches and missing cached taxonomy remain explicit withheld candidates; neither is a biological absence finding.
All cached query chains are complete and release-checked; bibliography memberships are not primary resistance validation.
Source label-definition conflicts are retained without automatic correction or evidence transfer.
CLI checks are read-only, new nested output parents are supported, and differing saved outputs are not overwritten.

unresolved_source_findings.finding: Label says MDR2; pinned definition begins MDR1.
Label says MDR4; pinned definition begins MDR1.

residual_risks: The literal, case-sensitive cache discovery is bounded, not an exhaustive UniProt alias search.
An ontology synonym may identify a source model or annotation rather than a gene; only the inspected leads were used.
Reference mappings do not resolve experimental allele, organism, genome or phenotype joins.
Source-supported alias and primary-evidence work remains open for the rest of the cohort and corpus.

full_authoritative_qc.limitation: RDKit is absent in the existing Intel macOS environment. No full authoritative QC or biological-curation verification is claimed.
